scope: On the Becoming core's laws of learning: within the uniform law family with distinguishable primitive effects, the three encounters of CompositionalAcquisition determine every expression (Becoming.Learning's Determines), and admitting its nonuniform law they determine nothing at the novel expression; a network's development under fixed weights is the orbit of its step; Hebbian development and a network going on under a route of updating are Becoming.Mechanism's adaptive systems, activity or the network having a law of its own exactly where the weights or the route make no difference, and in the three-unit memory and at the starting network they do; the responsive route learns exactly where the task fails. The grammar, probes, tasks, profiles, constants and routes keep the earlier modules' scope; correspondence to an actual learner or network is not checked.
